instruction:
Repair the native Altium board `C:\Users\user\Desktop\broken_sodimm_stackup.PcbDoc` and save the repaired document as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\sodimm_stackup.PcbDoc`. To use Altium Designer on Windows, run `D:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE` (adjust if your install path differs).

Restore these exact stackup fields: `V9_STACK_LAYER3_NAME=TOP`, `V9_STACK_LAYER5_NAME=SPLIT2`, `V9_STACK_LAYER7_NAME=S3`, `V9_STACK_LAYER9_NAME=VDD4`, `V9_STACK_LAYER11_NAME=S5`, `V9_STACK_LAYER13_NAME=S6`, `V9_STACK_LAYER15_NAME=SPLIT7`, and `V9_STACK_LAYER17_NAME=BOTTOM`. Set `V9_STACK_LAYER4_DIELCONST`, `V9_STACK_LAYER6_DIELCONST`, and `V9_STACK_LAYER8_DIELCONST` to `4.200`. Restore the enabled `Width_DQ` rule with `MAXLIMIT=3.937mil`, `MINLIMIT=3.5433mil`, and `PREFEREDWIDTH=3.937mil`, preserving its other existing rule fields.
